name: nema14-jst
description: NEMA14 JST guarded top-side layout study

scripts.source:check: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.config tsci build controller.tsx --routing-disabled && bun scripts/capture-native.ts
scripts.check:plug: bun scripts/describe-plug.ts artifacts/final-source.circuit.json artifacts/side-entry-plug.json && python3 scripts/check-plug-solids.py artifacts/final-source.circuit.json artifacts/side-entry-plug.json artifacts/plug-clearance.json
scripts.check: npm run source:check && npm run check:electrical && npm run check:placement && npm run check:locality && npm run check:critical-placement && npm run check:plug
scripts.autoroute: npm run check && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.config tsci build controller.tsx && bun scripts/capture-native.ts && npm run check:independent && npm run check:critical-routing
scripts.test:integration: mkdir -p .config/integration && bun experiments/integrated/check-native.ts artifacts/iteration-3/authored.circuit.json .config/integration/authored-native.json && bun experiments/integrated/check-native.ts artifacts/iteration-3/normal-attempt.circuit.json .config/integration/normal-native.json && ${PYTHON:-python3} scripts/test-integrated-kelvin.py && ${PYTHON:-python3} scripts/verify-integrated-kelvin.py artifacts/final-source.circuit.json artifacts/iteration-3/authored.circuit.json artifacts/iteration-3/normal-attempt.circuit.json .config/integration/authored-native.json .config/integration/normal-native.json .config/integration/verification.json
